scope: One 32K row per arm; not a full context sweep or acceptance sweep.
command: python bench/run_v100_bench.py --model-gguf REGULAR_IQ3_S_SHARD1 --base TEST_BASE --model qwen --only 32K --max-tokens 2048 --seed 68 --repeats 1 --out RESULTS_DIR
post_measurement_cleanup: Removed unused n_heads parameters from two CUDA kernels and their callers. No arithmetic changed. The incremental build passed.

controls.sampling: Unchanged runner defaults. Output lengths and continuations differ.
controls.verify_window: Equal to the block size; MTP uses 4.

caveats: One repetition per arm, with no statistical significance claim.
The 2048-token cap is not a forced output length.
The one-row prompt has 29495 tokens and differs from the 29494-token prompt in the earlier full six-row run. Do not mix those cohorts.
Draft time per window is an observed aggregate, not an isolated kernel microbenchmark.
All count-scan arms use the frozen executable; only df4-fused uses the fused executable.
delta_definition: Candidate minus MTP; percentage baseline is MTP.
